body:
PROBLEM. Plugin markdown is copied into consumer repositories or plugin caches, away from this repo's `docs/` tree. `/adlc-init` / `npx @adlc/opencode init` copies `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md` verbatim to `.opencode/skills/adlc/SKILL.md` (`plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs`, deploySkills). Its section "Rail enforcement in this harness" names `docs/ci/rails-guard.yml` and links [`docs/integrations/opencode.md`](../../../docs/integrations/opencode.md). Both files exist here and in neither place a consumer has, so the link dangles and `adlc skill-rot .opencode/skills` reports both as stale paths. The same relative-link pattern appears in exactly three other deployed files: `plugins/adlc-cursor/rules/adlc.mdc` (../../../docs/integrations/cursor.md, plus a bare `docs/ci/rails-guard.yml`), and `plugins/adlc-cursor/agents/prosecutor.md` and `plugins/adlc-claude-code/agents/prosecutor.md` (../../../docs/review-lenses/text-scanning-gates.md). Measured with `git ls-files 'plugins/**/*.md' 'plugins/**/*.mdc' 'skills/**/*.md'` minus README/CHANGELOG/test files: these are the only four relative links, and none resolves inside its plugin. The OpenCode router and the Cursor rule are GENERATED: their text lives in `scripts/router/router-model.mjs` (harness `rail-enforcement` sections) and `node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs` writes the six routers; `scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs` requires the committed files to equal the generator output byte for byte. Edit the model, then regenerate; never hand-edit a router. DECISIONS (full reasoning in `.adlc/specs/deployed-doc-links.md`). D1 Use absolute `https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/blob/main/` URLs. This follows the precedent set for #820 in PR #1377 (`plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-spec.md`, pinned by `plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs`). Pinning to a release tag is rejected: every release would have to rewrite the links, and nothing does that today. D2 Fix the source, not the deploy step. `scaffold.mjs` decides migration and de-duplication by comparing the deployed file with the source byte for byte (deploySkills: `readFileSync(outFile) === source`), and the other harnesses (Claude Code marketplace, Cursor, skills.sh) do not deploy through it, so a deploy-time rewrite would fix one harness and break the comparison. D3 Keep the code-span link text, for example [`docs/ci/rails-guard.yml`](https://...) in the ADLC repo, so a reader still sees the file name. The sibling skill-rot ticket (R4: a code span that is the whole text of an absolute-URL link is not a claim) keeps it from reading as a local path. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA. AC1 In `scripts/router/router-model.mjs`, the opencode and cursor `rail-enforcement` sections link `docs/ci/rails-guard.yml` and their integration doc (`docs/integrations/opencode.md`, `docs/integrations/cursor.md`) with https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/blob/main/... URLs. The regenerated `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md` and `plugins/adlc-cursor/rules/adlc.mdc` match. Verify: node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs --check && node --test scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs AC2 Both `agents/prosecutor.md` files link docs/review-lenses/text-scanning-gates.md by the absolute main URL. Verify: node --test scripts/test/deployed-doc-links.test.mjs AC3 New test `scripts/test/deployed-doc-links.test.mjs`: (a) no tracked markdown file under plugins/

/ (except README.md, CHANGELOG.md and test/) or skills// has a relative link target that resolves outside plugins/

/ or skills// or names a missing file; (b) every https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/(blob|tree)/main/ link in those files names a path that exists in this repo; (c) the test fails on a fixture containing ](../../../docs/x.md), so it bites. Verify: node --test scripts/test/deployed-doc-links.test.mjs AC4 The real deployed router yields no path claim from its rail-enforcement section: running @adlc/skill-rot's extractClaims over `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md` gives no path claim beginning `docs/`. Verify: node --test scripts/test/deployed-doc-links.test.mjs AC5 Deployment still copies verbatim and the deployed copy equals the source. Verify: node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/scaffold.test.mjs plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs AC6 Full suite and PR gates green. Verify: npm run preflight OUT OF SCOPE (listed in the spec for a follow-up issue). The many bare code-span mentions of ADLC-repo files in other deployed markdown, such as `docs/interrogation-protocol.md`, `docs/ci/adlc-maintenance.yml`, `docs/ci/rails-guard.yml` in the shared router prose and the init commands, and `scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs`. Also `scripts/test/rails-guard-workflow-hashes.json`, which the shared P5 router prose lists as a trust-root file and which does not exist even in this repo. A deploy-time rewrite in scaffold.mjs. Pinning links to a release tag. Plugin README links (READMEs are not deployed into consumer repos). DEPENDS ON the skill-rot command-claims ticket for AC4 (R4). TIER: scripts/router and plugin markdown are not trust-root paths (the trust-root plugin paths are plugins/adlc-opencode/lib, the hook directories and rails-checker.mjs), so a same-model P5 is sufficient.
title: Deployed plugin markdown: link ADLC repo docs by absolute GitHub URL instead of paths that dangle in consumer repos
